title: GPT-4.5
before: Each generation had come from more pretraining scale.
problem: Was there still headroom in scaling pretraining alone, now that reasoning was the growth area?
breakthrough: OpenAI's largest pretraining scale-up, positioned on warmth and fewer hallucinations rather than reasoning.
why: Read in hindsight as the end of the pure-pretraining era. It was retired within months as the reasoning line took over.
next: GPT-5 unified the reasoning and chat lines instead of scaling pretraining further.
inherits: A datapoint on the diminishing returns of pretraining scale alone.
